map.5味总重 50g，其中附子 10g 列入先煎；先煎 30-60 分钟后再下余药（: 5 herbs totaling 50 g, with 10 g of aconite listed for pre-boiling; pre-boil 30-60 minutes then add the rest (mint 6 g added in the last 5 minutes), giving about 90 minutes total, roughly double the routine 30-50 minutes, to reduce toxicity.
map.为什么有的药要后下？: Why are some herbs added late?
map.薄荷、藿香、砂仁等含挥发性成分，久煎会破坏有效组分；大黄后下保留泻下作用、钩藤后: Mint, patchouli and amomum contain volatile components that long decoction destroys, so their active constituents are lost; rhubarb added late keeps its purgative action and uncaria added late keeps its antihypertensive potency.
map.矿物、贝壳、角甲类（石膏、牡蛎、龟板等）一般先煎 20–30 分钟；有毒药材（附: Minerals, shells, horns and shells (gypsum, oyster shell, turtle shell) are generally pre-boiled 20-30 minutes; toxic herbs (aconite, aconite root) need 30-60 minutes or even longer to reduce toxicity, following medical advice and using the absence of a numb spicy sensation on tasting as the endpoint. After pre-boiling the other herbs (except the add-late ones) go in for co-decoction rather than changing the water. Never shorten the pre-boiling time for aconite-type herbs on your own.
